name: Olive Court Masjid
summary: A mosque and an olive branch grow from one foundation, balancing a slender minaret with a quiet living curve.
why: The doorway and dome share one centerline. The olive stem joins the prayer hall at the foundation and curves outward with deliberate breathing room; its leaves meet the stem. The branch balances the taller minaret on the other side.
risk: This is a softer and more illustrative identity; its smallest leaves simplify at launcher size.
reasonToChoose: You want peacefulness expressed beside a clear mosque.
